finalText:
Build clean, 0 errors, exit 0.

Two real bugs, rest just DEP-warning noise from bump:

1. `src/core/options.js` — used `options.retries`, new bundler hands `retryCount`. Fixed.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — strict check threw on `undefined` flag; new loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled (old default).

Build now finishes clean, `link ok` both stages.
